cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's sit and sort out our opening nights. Yours had empty seats? Mine had two people, and both left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Have my complimentary drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll share it. My theatre couldn't even afford to console us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you listen now? My dad left before my scene.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine asked for a refund. Can I keep the drink? I'll get you one when I've told you.

reason: Give A an actual consolation plan and sharing concession; B4 parental hurt prompts a worse personal claim and a revised drink bargain that reserves attention for A story first.
